newsitem.title: USA: First Union Real Estate to take loss.
newsitem.headline: First Union Real Estate to take loss.

text.p: First Union Real Estate Investments said Monday it had completed the sale of a retail mall property, taking a loss of some $5 million.
The company said it sold the mall in Wilkesboro, North Carolina to Lowe's Home Centers Inc for $9 million.
It said it will take the loss against the $14 million asset reserve that it recorded in 1995.
The company said it sold the mall to avoid the large capital expenditures and re-leasing costs associated with its turnaround.
Lowe's of North Wilkesboro, North Carolina is a home center retailers operating over 390 stores in 24 states.
First Union Real Estate Investments specializes in owning, operating and repositioning properties.
